faqs.question: What does JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test measure?
faqs.answer: The JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test initially detects the JAK2 V617F mutation. If JAK2 V617F mutation is not detected, further mutation analysis for Jak2 Ex-12, MPL W515/S505, and CALR Ex-9 is indicated.

faqs.question: Why is JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test done?
faqs.answer: • To confirm the diagnosis of myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN) in suspected cases • To differentiate MPN from other blood disorders. • To guide treatment decisions and monitor the response to therapy in • MPN patients

faqs.question: When is JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for individuals who have • symptoms suggestive of MPN such as unexplained fatigue, night sweats, or an enlarged spleen, • abnormal blood cell counts or other laboratory findings indicating a potential blood disorder, or • a family history of MPN or genetic risk factors for MPN.

faqs.question: What if the results of the JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: If the JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test shows an abnormal result, it may indicate the presence of a mutation associated with MPN.

faqs.question: What to expect during the JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test?
faqs.answer: During the test, a bone marrow sample is collected using a needle. The sample is sent to the laboratory for analysis using real-time PCR, Sanger sequencing and PCR fragment analysis methods.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test?
faqs.answer: • A clinical diagnosis and test prescription from your doctor are mandatory. • Avoid any dietary restrictions unless advised by your doctor. • Inform your doctor about any medications or supplements you are taking that may interfere with the test results. Also, tell them if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test?
faqs.answer: • MPL W515/S505 Mutation Analysis: This test checks for mutations in the MPL gene associated with myeloproliferative neoplasms. • CALR Ex-9 Mutation Analysis: This test detects mutations in the CALR gene, which may also be involved in myeloproliferative neoplasms.

faqs.question: What is the JAK2 V617 Mutation Reflex Test also known as?
faqs.answer: JAK2 Ex-12, MPL W515/S505 or CALR Ex-9 Mutation Analysis

faqs.question: What are myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPN)?
faqs.answer: Myeloproliferative neoplasms are a group of blood disorders characterised by the overproduction of blood cells in the bone marrow. MPN includes conditions such as polycythemia vera (PV), essential thrombocythemia (ET), and primary myelofibrosis (PMF).
